plan.summary: This 4-week block starts a 12-week off-camp boxing plan built around 3 short S&C sessions per week that fit around higher sparring loads. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lifts so future percentage work is anchored to your real numbers, and the main build starts in Week 2. The emphasis here is simple force and power development with low-complexity jumps, med-ball-style explosive work using minimal equipment, and enough accessory work to support posture, trunk strength, and shoulder health without stealing energy from boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish baseline strength, build simple power, and raise general force output with recoverable volume.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts and explosive work while keeping lifting volume trimmed around boxing demands.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength, sharpen power and speed, and carry the earlier work into faster sport-relevant output.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a low safe box and stick each landing quietly. Reset between reps and keep every jump crisp.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you do not have a stable box. Jump fast and land softly.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with small jumps in load, then build to one hard clean set of 3-5 reps. This sets your baseline for future percentage work, so stop if depth or posture breaks.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your training max.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the best clean top set load and reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
